title: GO:0000018 · Temporal: score distributions
caption: Distribution of test-set scores for positives and negatives, GO:0000018 temporal split. The vertical line is the default decision threshold. SVM (RBF) on Conjoint triad: median score -0.39 for positives against -0.52 for negatives; Logistic regression on k-sep. bigram PSSM: median score 0.94 for positives against 0.04 for negatives. Overlap between the two histograms is what limits AUROC, whatever the threshold.
